title: Custom Tree Bookshelf: Sizes, Wood Finishes and Pricing
meta_description: Handcrafted rustic tree bookshelves start at $1679.00. Compare 20 solid wood designs, custom sizing options, and DIY vs on-site installation setup.
body_html:
A custom tree bookshelf from Wrydeco starts at $1679.00 for a 40" x 40" x 10"D unit. The right choice depends on your wall width, ceiling clearance, whether you want live-edge branches with sculpted leaves, and whether you prefer DIY mounting or scheduled on-site installation.

In this guide

  1. What defines a rustic tree bookshelf, and which design fits your room?
  2. Which standard or custom size should you choose?
  3. Which solid wood finish matches your home?
  4. Should you assemble it yourself or add on-site installation?
  5. Worked example: sizing a live-edge tree bookshelf for an accent wall

What defines a rustic tree bookshelf, and which design fits your room?

A rustic tree bookshelf uses organic trunk profiles and spreading limb shelves to provide vertical book storage that resembles a growing tree. Unlike conventional rectangular bookcases, each branch offers varying shelf spans, natural wood grain variation, and optional carved leaf accents. Wrydeco's rustic tree bookshelf collection comprises 20 distinct products priced from $1679.00 to $10249.00, built from solid hardwood. You can compare all 20 rustic tree bookshelves to evaluate trunk styles and branch spreads.

How to apply it: determine whether you need a flat wall-mounted unit or a corner-spanning design. Flat wall models like the Tall Trunk design need continuous drywall, while corner models utilize the intersection of two adjoining walls. Check whether you prefer clean geometric branch lines or live-edge silhouettes with carved foliage.

What to check

  • Whether your wall has adequate uninterrupted space without wall sconces or vents
  • Clearance from adjoining furniture so branches do not crowd seating
  • Preference for minimalist branches versus intricate leaf carvings
  • Ceiling height relative to vertical branch tips

Which standard or custom size should you choose?

Standard sizes across the collection start at compact 40'' x 40'' x 10''D units and scale up to expansive 89"W x 82"H x 12''D wall installations:

  • 40'' x 40'' x 10''D: starts at $1679.00. Ideal for compact bedrooms or accent spaces.
  • 50'' x 50'' x 10''D: starts at $2375.00. A balanced square layout for medium walls.
  • 45''H x 35''W x 8''D: starts at $2598.00. A slim vertical format for tight spaces.
  • 43''W x 40''H x 10''D: starts at $2683.00. Suited for low-ceiling alcoves or home offices.
  • 35''H x 35''W x 10''D: starts at $2794.00. Compact square accent format.
  • 65\"W x 60\"H x 10\"D: starts at $2838.55. The most popular size for living room accent walls.
  • 65''W x 65''H x 12''D: starts at $2875.00. Deeper shelving for large hardcover books.
  • 30''W x 35''H x 10''D: starts at $2989.00. Narrow profile with generous depth.

[IMAGE: wrydeco_logo_39305891741786.jpg]

Size customization is available on 12 of the 20 product pages. If your measured wall space falls between standard production sizes, custom width and height configurations can be confirmed before placing your order.

[IMAGE: wrydeco_logo_39305891774554.jpg]

How to apply it: mark the overall width and height on your wall using blue painter's tape. Step back across the room to observe sightlines from doorways and seating. Ensure that the outer branch tips leave at least 6 inches of breathing room from window frames, room corners, and ceiling moldings.

What to check

  • Wall width measured at the exact installation height
  • Floor-to-ceiling clearance, leaving space above the top boughs
  • Depth needed for your book collection (8" for standard paperbacks, 10" to 12" for art books)
  • Presence of electrical outlets or light switches that the trunk or branches might cover

Which solid wood finish matches your home?

The rustic tree bookshelf collection offers nine wood finishes: Natural, Natural Finish, Light Oak, Walnut, Dark Walnut, Warm Wood, Dark Warm Wood, Cool Dark Wood, and Custom. Base pricing on selected 45''H x 35''W models starts at $2598.00 across Natural, Light Oak, Walnut, Dark Walnut, and Custom options.

[IMAGE: wrydeco_logo_39305883287642.jpg]

  • Natural and Natural Finish: highlights light honey tones and raw wood grain patterns. Well suited for modern organic, coastal, and Scandinavian rooms.
  • Light Oak: provides golden undertones with pronounced ray fleck patterns, matching light hardwood floors.
  • Walnut: delivers a versatile medium chocolate tone that coordinates with mid-century and transitional interiors.
  • Dark Walnut and Dark Warm Wood: offers rich espresso shades that contrast sharply against white, cream, or light gray walls.
  • Cool Dark Wood: presents muted dark charcoal and ash undertones, suited for contemporary urban spaces.
  • Custom: formulated to match existing cabinetry, crown molding, or flooring samples.

[IMAGE: wrydeco_logo_39305883320410.jpg]

How to apply it: hold wood finish swatches against both your flooring and your wall paint under morning and evening lighting. If your room features dominant warm wood floors, choose Walnut or Warm Wood to unify the space. For strong architectural presence, select a contrasting tone like Dark Walnut against light drywall.

What to check

  • Dominant wood tones in flooring and adjacent trim
  • Lighting exposure throughout the day in the chosen room
  • Level of natural grain contrast desired on branch surfaces
  • Custom stain match requirements for existing millwork

Should you assemble it yourself or add on-site installation?

Rustic tree bookshelves are structural solid wood installations that must anchor securely into wall framing studs. On 40'' x 40'' units starting at $1679.00, self-assembly is the base option. Customers who prefer professional setup can select on-site installation, starting at $2079.00 (a $400.00 addition for coordinated assembly).

[IMAGE: wrydeco_logo_39305883779162.jpg]

  • DIY Self-Assembly ($1679.00 base): includes pre-machined joinery, mounting hardware, and assembly documentation. Requires a stud finder, bubble level, power drill, and two adults to position heavy solid hardwood components.
  • On-Site Installation ($2079.00 scheduled): Wrydeco's installation team contacts you to coordinate scheduling, transports the unit into your room, locates wall studs, anchors the structure, and verifies that all branch shelves are level and secure.

[IMAGE: wrydeco_logo_39305883811930.jpg]

How to apply it: assess your wall structure and DIY comfort level. If your wall is standard drywall over wood studs spaced at 16 inches, DIY installation is straightforward with proper tools. If you have plaster-and-lath walls, metal studs, or high ceiling placements, professional on-site installation eliminates structural mounting concerns.

What to check

  • Wall construction type (standard drywall over wood studs, masonry, or plaster)
  • Availability of a stud finder, level, and impact drill for self-assembly
  • Weight capacity requirements for heavy personal libraries
  • Lead time and scheduling availability for on-site installation services

Worked example: sizing a live-edge tree bookshelf for an accent wall

This worked example uses realistic hypothetical wall dimensions to demonstrate the selection process from measurement to final specifications.

Consider an accent wall in a living room that measures 120 inches wide and features a standard 96-inch ceiling height. The wall has a sofa centered on it, leaving 65 inches of open vertical space above the sofa back.

  1. Width selection: A 65"W unit occupies just over half the wall width, leaving roughly 27.5 inches of open wall on each side. This provides balanced proportions without crowding the corners.
  2. Height selection: The 65"W x 60"H x 10"D model stands 60 inches tall. Mounted 6 inches above the top of the sofa back, the top branch reaches 66 inches above the furniture, leaving 4 inches of clear space below the ceiling molding.
  3. Depth selection: A 10" depth holds standard 9" hardcover books securely while keeping the shelf from protruding uncomfortably into the room walkway.
  4. Finish selection: The room features natural white oak flooring and gray walls. Selecting Dark Walnut provides a rich silhouette that emphasizes the organic tree branches.
  5. Cost and setup: The 65"W x 60"H x 10"D configuration in Dark Walnut starts at $2838.55 for self-installation. Adding scheduled on-site installation provides complete mounting peace of mind.

[IMAGE: wrydeco_logo_39305884106842.jpg]
